bias.en: Bearish · oversold, holding the January lows
bias.zh: 看空 · 超卖，守住 1 月低点

read.en: Teradyne rose 2.6% on Nov 6 to $218.22, fading from a $234.48 high (low $211.91). It is below the falling 5-day ($242.5), 10-day ($272.9), 30-day ($343.8) and 100-day ($367.2) averages and the rising 200-day ($349.9). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($268.61), and RSI is 24, oversold.
read.zh: 泰瑞达 11月6日上涨 2.6%，收于 $218.22，自盘中高点 $234.48 回落（低点 $211.91）。股价位于下行的 5 日（$242.5）、10 日（$272.9）、30 日（$343.8）和 100 日均线（$367.2）以及上行的 200 日均线（$349.9）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方且在零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$268.61），RSI 为 24，处于超卖区。

read.en: No level changed: the bounce failed under $227, and the Nov 6 low ($211.91) held the January-low support again. Resistance is $227 (Jan 26 low), then $234.5–242.1 (Nov 6 high, Jan 29–Feb 2 lows, Nov 5 high) and $245.9–246.8. Support is $211.6–212.6 (Nov 5–6, Jan 5 and Jan 8 lows), then $199.3–200 and $193.4 (Dec 31 low). A close above $227 would target $234–242; below $211.6, $200.

r.en: Nov 6 high $234.48; Jan 29–Feb 2 lows ($238.8–240.7); Nov 5 high $242.05
